# pheno-go-ctxkit

## Overview

Canonical Go context utilities for the `pheno-*` fleet.
Provides per-request UUID generation, structured logger injection/extraction,
and a small `net/http` middleware that wires both together and emits a
single structured "request.complete" log line.

## Install

```go
import "github.com/kooshapari/pheno-go-ctxkit/ctxkit"
```

## Quickstart

```go
// In your main router:
http.Handle("/", ctxkit.Middleware(yourHandler))

// Inside a handler:
id := ctxkit.RequestID(r.Context())
logger := ctxkit.Logger(r.Context())
logger.Info("handling request", "id", id)
```

## API

- `WithRequestID(ctx, id)` / `RequestID(ctx)` — store/extract request ID
- `NewRequestID()` — generate RFC 4122 v4 UUID (stdlib only, no deps)
- `WithLogger(ctx, logger)` / `Logger(ctx)` — store/extract structured logger
- `Background()` — `context.Background` pre-populated with a fresh request ID
- `Middleware(next)` — HTTP middleware that wires ID + logger + access log
